verdict.line: You lose if Riven snowballs her level 2-5 all-in or scales unanswered into Blade of the Exile; you win if you convert your lane and solo-kill edge into tempo before mid game.

brief.thesis: K'Sante holds the lane advantage and the solo-kill advantage in this matchup, but the aggregate win rate is only 44.2% over 618 games, which means the lane lead does not carry itself into the rest of the game. Riven's Q (Broken Wings) reset and E (Valor) damage-block let her play a dash-heavy, low-commitment trade pattern, while K'Sante's tools are stronger at punishing a committed all-in than at winning a poke war. The lane is yours to take if you force her into cooldown windows; it slips if you let her reset freely and the game run long.

theirWindow.when: Riven lands W (Ki Burst) stun on you
theirWindow.what: She chains into Q (Broken Wings)'s up-to-three hits and empowered autos from Runic Blade for her full combo. Hold E (Footwork)'s shield before she's level 2, and don't sit in W range until your own W (Path Maker) is rank 2 and can eat the burst while charging.

yourWindow.what: Her incoming-damage block is gone, so step up and land Q (Ntofo Strikes) for free stacks toward the 2-stack shockwave, or commit W (Path Maker) for the knockback-stun since she has nothing left to block it with.

start.why: Picked in 85.5% of games (46.7% win rate over 627 games); the extra sustain through Runic Blade-empowered autos matters more here than the shield variant's burst mitigation.

boots.why: 83.5% pick rate at 46% win rate; Riven's damage is auto-attack and burst heavy, and the flat basic-attack reduction directly undercuts her Runic Blade-charged hits.

core.why: Mana to actually cast Q (Ntofo Strikes) on cooldown and an AoE slow on-hit to keep sticking to Riven after she dashes away with E (Valor).
Omnivamp and a damage-reduction shield proc give you sustain through her poke, which matters since she resets range for free with Q (Broken Wings).
Converts the bonus health you're already stacking into both resistances, which is what closes the late-game gap this matchup shows on paper.

her Q (Broken Wings) resets and E (Valor) dashes are making her impossible to pin down
you need more healing power to out-sustain her poke instead of flat damage reduction

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off your first hit on Riven roughly every few seconds, which lines up with your 3.5s Q (Ntofo Strikes) cooldown, and the bonus health it grants directly feeds the Jak'Sho scaling your build is going for.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite measures the highest win rate (50.5%) and converts your existing solo-kill advantage into actual kills; Flash + Teleport is the far more common pick (73.1%) if you'd rather play the siege and scaling macro instead.

playing.title: Bait E (Valor) before trading
playing.detail: Throw a poke auto or your first Q (Ntofo Strikes) hit in; if she answers with E (Valor) she only blocks that single hit, so load your real trade into the window right after her E goes on cooldown.

playing.title: Hold W through her all-in
playing.detail: Her W (Ki Burst) into Q (Broken Wings) chain is the kill pattern from level 2 on. Charge W (Path Maker) to eat the burst with reduced damage, then knock her out of range.

playing.title: Stack Q for the pull
playing.detail: Two landed Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits fire a shockwave that pulls her in — use it to cut off the third hit of her Broken Wings chain or to catch her right after an E (Valor) dash.

playing.title: Respect the full Broken Wings chain
playing.detail: Q (Broken Wings) can be reactivated up to three times in quick succession; if her first hit lands, assume two more are coming and hold Footwork's shield for the whole chain, not just the opener.

playing.title: Convert the lane lead early
playing.detail: Your 44.2% matchup win rate despite a measured lane and solo-kill edge means she catches up later — shove and look to roam off your advantage around levels 6-8 instead of sitting in lane to scale.

playing.title: Commit R, don't panic it
playing.detail: All Out (R) knocks her through terrain and locks you into its transformed kit with reduced defenses, so only cast it when you can follow up on the knockback — its 120s cooldown at rank 1 punishes a wasted use.

playing.title: Track her ultimate timer after level 6
playing.detail: Once she has R (Blade of the Exile) up, her Wind Slash and empowered autos spike hard. Play around that cooldown (120/90/60/60/10s) rather than just her base combo.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, trade timings, and tactical reasoning are my own read on the matchup.
